# User Profile Service

## Purpose
The User Profile Service manages personalized data and preferences for individual users. It allows for the storage and retrieval of user-specific configurations, profile attributes, and metadata, ensuring a consistent and personalized experience across the platform.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UserProfile** | `/plugins/UserProfile/getAllUserProfiles` | POST | Lists user profiles. |
| **UserProfile** | `/plugins/UserProfile/createUserProfile` | POST | Creates a new user profile. |

## Dependencies
- **user-profile-model**: Core profile entities.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Profile Extension**: Decouples personal information (like gender, phone) from the core authentication user entity.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as UserProfileController
    participant Service as UserProfileService

    User->>Controller: createUserProfile(UserProfileCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createUserProfile(UserProfileCreate)
    Service-->>User: Profile Created and Linked to User
```
